business_problem: Yum China needed to support large volumes of customer inquiries across its KFC, Pizza Hut, and other digital channels, while improving self-service resolution in complex order and after-sales scenarios rather than depending only on static FAQ-style bots or human escalation.
solution_summary: Yum China and Baidu AI Cloud Keyue deployed a multi-channel AI customer-service system across the company's app, mini-programs, and delivery platforms. Keyue extends beyond fixed knowledge-base Q&A by combining large-model intent recognition, multi-turn conversation, and contextual problem handling so the assistant can interpret a customer's goal and adapt its response accordingly. The system covers practical service flows such as campaign consultation, invoice issuance, and order changes, and it performs especially well in more difficult催单 scenarios where the model must combine the current question with contextual business data to recommend a suitable next step. The same architecture raises the quality of dialogue while also reducing the need for manual intervention. In effect, Yum China turned its customer-service stack into a large-model-powered self-service operation that can absorb high traffic, deliver consistent brand support across channels, and keep improving the economics of service delivery.

solution_components.name: Baidu AI Cloud Keyue
solution_components.role: Runs the multi-channel intelligent customer-service experience for Yum China, combining intent recognition, multi-turn dialogue, and contextual response handling.

data_flow: Customer requests arrive through Yum China's app, mini-programs, and delivery platforms, Keyue interprets intent and context, retrieves or generates the right service response for issues such as campaigns, invoices, or order changes, and only escalates to humans when self-service logic cannot resolve the case.
business_outcome: Yum China increased answer quality and self-service resolution while handling very large customer-service volumes across digital channels and reducing reliance on human agents.
architecture_clues: The deployment runs across app, mini-program, and delivery-platform channels rather than one customer-service front end.
The model uses contextual business data for difficult催单 scenarios rather than only relying on FAQ retrieval.
The same system serves multiple Yum China brands.
